comparison.objective: Remove an obstruction and insert a knife into a holder; candidate adjusts and locks a gripper opening stop.
comparison.physical_skill: Safe obstacle removal followed by narrow-slot knife insertion versus coupled screw/nut tool manipulation and torque regulation.
comparison.success_condition: Knife inserted to specified depth and pose, with full credit only if the toy is safely released outside the holder; invalid or fallen states fail.
comparison.reason: Clearing an insertion path and storing a blade tests obstacle handling and alignment, not angular calibration or jam-nut retention.
